evidence_requirements: Versioned exact candidate/source/build/artifact receipts; identify current checkout versus frozen candidate explicitly.
Real signed sessions acquired through actual credential sign-in; preserve private credentials separately, no preseeded or fabricated signed auth cookie.

Replay genuinely issued pre-repair signed session_data against repaired authority before its original expiry when testing legacy cache. Record cookie name/value hash/expiry/remaining lifetime without value.
Capture request response status/length/hash/private-canary flags and safe authentication-header effects; do not store passwords/tokens/cookie strings.
Compare native before/after business/account/session/audit state per request after exact invalidation transition. Denials must cause no unauthorized changes.
Authorized effects must be exact: chosen own secondary unlink, reviewed own-profile delta, classified login bookkeeping and own cleanup only.
Keep raw harness mismatches separate; use source contract rather than inventing expected status. Incrementally persist sanitized evidence and bounded cleanup.
Run independent recipe/result review; no case counted from source alone.

legacy_cache_bridge.allowed: Acquire genuine signed session+cache using independently reviewed pre-repair source/runtime against the new isolated target with identical local signing secret, then test repaired target without changing cookie contents and while cache remains unexpired.
legacy_cache_bridge.forbidden_inference: Absence of newly issued cache cookies does not prove that existing signed legacy cache is ignored.

excluded: Hosted OAuth/token exchange and provider delivery positives.
Unrelated media upload/provider/whole inventory Refresh matrices.
Production, migrations outside new disposable target, deployment or committed changes.
Claim of instantaneous revocation or transaction-level linearizability without dedicated race evidence.

supplementary_recommended_controls.acceptance: Active/unlocked real session core identity works without tenant or roles; application /api/me stays under its existing stronger admission. Requires reviewed fixture support.

Core own-session policy is active/unlocked identity; changing verification flags after legitimate issuance does not silently import full application RBAC. Preserve existing application verification denial.
